title: Sparse Table: Range Maximum Query
statement:
Given an array of N integers and Q queries, for each query (L, R) (0-indexed) find the maximum value in the subarray A[L..R].

Use a Sparse Table for O(1) per query after O(N log N) preprocessing.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and Q.
The second line contains N integers.
The next Q lines each contain L and R (0-indexed).
outputFormat: Q lines, each the maximum of A[L..R].

starterCode.python:
n, q = map(int, input().split())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
queries = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(q)]
# Write your solution here
# Hint: sp[j][i] = max of arr[i..i+2^j-1]
